subject: MAP: Integration implementation playbook — SDK streaming & tool-calls (Ava Health)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lind <sara.lind@avahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Integration implementation playbook — SDK streaming & tool-calls (Ava Health)

Hi Sara — great conversation today, thanks for the time. As promised, attached is a first-pass MAP (MAP_Draft_AvaHealth_v1.xlsx) focused on the integration milestone we'll need to hit to validate production readiness. This email is a concise post-call recap and asks for confirmation on owners and a target close window.

High-level recap:
- Goal: Ship SDK integration with streaming + tool-calling hooks and structured outputs for the Claims Assist workflow; enable low-latency inference under 150ms p50 for short prompts.
- Target commercial close: target week of Sep 20, 2026 (TBD) — tentative based on integration sign-offs.

Proposed integration milestone checklist (summary — full rows in attached MAP):
1) SDK onboarding + API keys (owner: Redwood SDK team) — target: 2026-08-20
2) Streaming end-to-end POC (owner: Ava dev / Redwood infra eng) — target: 2026-09-03
3) Tool-calling hooks (external HTTP actions + auth) (owner: Redwood integrations) — target: 2026-09-10
4) Structured output schema & validation (owner: Ava schema lead / Redwood PM) — target: 2026-09-07
5) Load test & perf tuning (owner: Redwood performance team) — target: 2026-09-14

Dependencies we discussed: VPC peering & network routes, service account keys, sample payloads for structured outputs, and a shared sandbox dataset for perf tuning.

Can you confirm the following by EOD Wednesday?
- Do the owners above map to your internal teams?
- Any constraints on the proposed dates (can't meet / need to shift)?
- Preferred time for a 30-min technical sync this week to go over streaming and tool-calls?

Attachments: MAP_Draft_AvaHealth_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks — I can update the MAP after your notes and circulate an owner-validated version.

—
Camila Reyes
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Sara Lind <sara.lind@avahealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: solutions@avahealth.com
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 17:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration implementation playbook — SDK streaming & tool-calls (Ava Health)

Camila — thanks, this looks like a clean starting point. Quick responses below: 

- Owners: I'll own the schema and product side (Sara Lind). Engineering leads will be Ben Torres (ben.torres@avahealth.com) for SDK work and Priya Singh (pri.singh@avahealth.com) for streaming. I'll introduce them on the tech sync.
- Dates: SDK onboarding by Aug 20 is tight because we have a sprint freeze Aug 16–22. Can we shift the SDK onboarding to Aug 27 and slide downstream dates by one week?
- Tool-calling: We need to confirm OAuth flow with our security team; I expect a potential extra week.

Let's set the 30-min tech sync for Thu Aug 5, 9:00am PT if that works for your engineers.

Appreciate the clear milestones — please update the MAP with the shifted dates and I'll validate.

Best,
Sara
VP Product, Ava Health
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MAP: Integration implementation playbook — owner confirmations + ask for engineering feasibility

Team — forwarding Sara's notes from Ava. Key asks: confirm feasibility of shifting SDK onboarding to Aug 27 and impact on streaming / tool-calls. Please review the summary below and confirm owners and parity items so I can update the MAP and send back to Sara.

Summary (action items for engineering):
- SDK onboarding & API keys: proposed owner = Dev (Dev Patel) — confirm that creating sandbox keys + sample SDK snippet is feasible by Aug 27.
- Streaming E2E POC: proposed owner = Laura (infra lead) + Ava's Priya — confirm whether the streaming latency target (p50 <150ms for short prompts) is realistic with the sandbox data and whether we should schedule an internal perf run. Proposed target after slide: Sep 10.
- Tool-calling hooks: owner = Jordan (integrations) — need to validate OAuth flow dependencies and whether our hosted integrations support Ava's OAuth requirements. If additional engineering needed, provide estimate. Proposed target after slide: Sep 17.
- Structured outputs schema: owner = Marissa (solutions) + Sara (Ava) — need sample payloads by Aug 13 to lock schema.
- Load testing & perf tuning: owner = Redwood performance team (Laura) — plan a perf run week of Sep 13.

Dependencies / blockers to call out now:
- VPC peering request + firewall rules (Ava to raise ticket)
- Sandbox service account + secrets access (we provide short-lived keys)
- OAuth scope confirmation for tool-calls and test client credentials
- Acceptance criteria for structured outputs (schema + sample set)

Attachments: integration-checklist.pdf (pdf) — I've added a condensed checklist for engineering.

Can each of you reply with a single-line confirmation and any date shifts by EOD tomorrow so I can re-issue the MAP to the customer.

—
Camila
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP: Integration implementation playbook — owner confirmations + ask for engineering feasibility

Camila / team — quick confirmations and risks: 

- SDK onboarding & API keys: I can own sandbox key issuance and a minimal SDK snippet by Aug 27. We'll provide Node + Python examples and a short README. No major blockers.
- Streaming E2E POC: Laura and I will pair with Priya (Ava) on the tech sync. Note: achieving p50 <150ms in a cross-cloud sandbox may require tuning; I'll budget 3 days for kernel/config tuning once we have traffic patterns. Proposed adjusted milestone: Sep 10 (OK).
- Tool-calling hooks (OAuth): OAuth is the main risk. If Ava requires an enterprise OAuth flow (idp initiated SSO or signed JWT client auth), that could add 1–2 weeks. Jordan, can you confirm whether we have an out-of-box OAuth flow that will fit Ava?
- Structured outputs: Marissa, please confirm acceptance tests — we need sample payloads by Aug 13 as noted.
- Load testing: We'll run a staged load run week of Sep 13; we should reserve dedicated infra for the test.

Acceptance criteria notes (engineering):
- SDK onboarding: sample app can authenticate and run 100 concurrent short requests in sandbox without errors.
- Streaming: end-to-end streaming with reconnect semantics and recovery for connection drops
- Tool-calls: auth flow completes and calls to external hooks succeed with <500ms median additional latency
- Structured outputs: schema conformance + 95% pass rate on validator on sample set.

I'll be on the Thu Aug 5 9:00am PT tech sync.

—
Dev Patel
Senior Software Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration implementation playbook — SDK streaming & tool-calls (Ava Health)

Sara — thanks for the quick turnaround and for confirming owners. Per the internal responses below we've updated the MAP to reflect the slide by one week and accounted for potential OAuth variability. Updated target milestones (customer-facing):
- SDK onboarding & API keys: Aug 27 (owner: Dev Patel / Redwood)
- Streaming E2E POC: Sep 10 (owner: Laura Bennett / Priya Singh (Ava))
- Structured outputs schema locked: Aug 13 (owner: Marissa / Sara)
- Tool-calling hooks: Sep 17 (owner: Jordan) — note this may move +1–2 weeks pending OAuth details
- Perf & load validation: week of Sep 13 (owner: Laura)

Next steps:
1) Tech sync Thu Aug 5, 9:00am PT (Dev, Laura, Priya) — confirm joining link in calendar invite.
2) Ava to share sample payloads and OAuth requirements by Aug 10.
3) Redwood to issue sandbox keys and SDK snippet by Aug 27.

I've updated the MAP in Drive (link above) and re-attached the version we shared earlier. If acceptable, we'll treat the dates above as MAP commitments and include them in the commercial schedule for the Sep 20 close window. Please confirm and I'll lock the MAP.

Thanks everyone — Camila

—
